senses.gloss: doing good, esp. a vow to benefit one’s self (or others), opp. הרעה self-abnegation (or harm to others).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shevuot 3:5">Shebu. III, 5</cite> <he>דברים שיש בהן הרעה או ה׳</he> vows in which a self-abnegation or an enjoyment is implied.
<cite ref="Shevuot 27a:7">Ib. 27ᵃ</cite> <he>מה ה׳ רשות וכ׳</he> as well as the vow of enjoyment refers to something religiously indifferent, so &c.
<cite ref="Shevuot 27a:10">Ib.</cite> <he>הֲטָבַת אחרים</he> a vow comprising a benefit to others; a. fr.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 32:2">Lev. R. s. 32</cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:14:4">Cant. R. to II, 14</cite>, a. e. (ref. to <he>היטיבו</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 18:17">Deut. XVIII, 17</cite>) <he>ה׳ כהֲטָבַת הנרות</he> a well considered word (which has its effect) like well-trimmed lights; <he>כה׳ הקטורת</he> like the well-prepared frank-incense.
